description: Add an account webhook: signed POSTs (Standard Webhooks + CloudEvents) to an https URL for events such as feed.item.published (new items in feeds you follow), feed.followed, feed.created, submission.approved. Patterns like feed.* work; omit events for all. Returns the signing secret. Needs a key.

description.description: A note for yourself (optional), e.g. staging receiver

events.description: Event types or patterns, default all, e.g. ["feed.*", "submission.approved"]

url.description: Public https URL that receives the POSTs, e.g. https://example.com/hooks/nichedb

name: create_webhook
